+# WeilConjectures.PoincareDuality.Poincare local elaboration attributes
+
+## Reason
+
+The retained proof elaboration avoids expanding the K-injective internal-Hom structure
+and the coefficient pullback construction. Prefer the full-subcategory monoidal
+instance locally so that typeclass search uses the existing structure directly.
+These commands have local scope: none is exported to an importing module. The
+preflight conservatively classifies commands outside declaration bodies as interface
+changes and requests this record. No existing public declaration, definition body,
+public import, theorem signature or global attribute changes.
+
+## Old
+
+No local attribute commands at the start of the public section.
+
+## New
+
+```lean
+attribute [local irreducible] DerivedCategory.monoidalClosed
+  CategoryTheory.Mod.monoidalClosed AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStarFromPoint
+
+attribute [local instance 2000] CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.fullMonoidalSubcategory
+```
+
+The trace-cup proof now supplies its four abstract arguments explicitly. The isomorphism
+proof first proves the generic composition-of-isomorphisms assertion in a private,
+fully proved helper, then instantiates it with the existing Verdier exchange theorem.
+The source module also imports the two proved Sheaf helper modules privately and proves
+the shifted zero-twist case in a private theorem. No arbitrary data is chosen.
+
+## Users
+
+Source-only audit:
+`python3 tools/downstream.py WeilConjectures.PoincareDuality.Poincare --uses
+AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.boundedConstructible_tateTwistDerived`.
+The only declaration-level use is the wrapper in the item itself.
+
+| module | group holding it | effect |
+|---|---|---|
+| WeilConjectures.PoincareDuality.Poincare | G3 | Local elaboration only; same public signatures and definition bodies. |
+| TargetsCheck | unclaimed | Imports the same public API; local attributes are not exported. |
+| WeilConjectures | unclaimed | Imports the same public API; local attributes are not exported. |
+
+No consumer adaptation is needed. No target changes its meaning, and no target semantic
+review is reopened by these local commands.
+
+## Status
+
+landed 20261017T131009-L-1769097 2026-10-17 (merge of deliver/G3/WeilConjectures.PoincareDuality.Poincare)

@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+/-

+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: SHEAF contributors
+-/
+module
+
+public import WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.ProEtaleModule.DerivedCategory
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.FullyFaithful
+
+/-! Geometric and shift components of the bounded-constructibility argument. -/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+universe u u'
+
+open CategoryTheory MonoidalCategory MonoidalClosed
+open MonObj Limits ZeroObject
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale
+variable {A : Type u'} [Category.{u + 1} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} A]
+  [MonoidalCategory A] [MonoidalPreadditive A] [SymmetricCategory A] [MonoidalClosed A]
+  {X : Scheme.{u}}
+  (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) [MonObj R]
+private lemma constructible_of_iso
+    {M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) R} (e : M ≅ N)
+    (hM : IsConstructibleModuleObject R M) : IsConstructibleModuleObject R N := by
+  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hM
+  refine ⟨S, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨𝒰, h𝒰⟩ := hS a
+  refine ⟨𝒰, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨n, m, f, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := h𝒰 i
+  exact ⟨n, m, f, ⟨(((ProEtale.upperStar A (S.immersion a)).mapMod R ⋙
+    (ProEtale.upperStar A (𝒰.f i)).mapMod _).mapIso e).symm ≪≫ e'⟩⟩
+
+private lemma locallyFinitelyPresented_of_isZero
+    {M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) R} (hM : IsZero M) :
+    IsLocallyFinitelyPresented R M := by
+  refine ⟨.singleton (𝟙 X) (Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isIso _), fun i ↦ ?_⟩
+  refine ⟨0, 0, 𝟙 _, ⟨?_⟩⟩
+  exact (((ProEtale.upperStar A _).mapMod R).map_isZero hM).iso
+    (isZero_cokernel_of_epi (𝟙 _))
+
+private lemma constructible_of_isZero
+    {M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) R} (hM : IsZero M) :
+    IsConstructibleModuleObject R M := by
+  let S : Scheme.Stratification X :=
+    { n := 1
+      stratum := fun _ ↦ Set.univ
+      isLocallyClosed_stratum := fun _ ↦ isOpen_univ.isLocallyClosed
+      isConstructible_stratum := fun _ ↦ Topology.IsConstructible.univ
+      iUnion_stratum_eq_univ := Set.iUnion_const _
+      pairwise_disjoint_stratum := fun i j hij ↦ (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
+      domain := fun _ ↦ X
+      immersion := fun _ ↦ 𝟙 X
+      range_immersion := fun _ ↦ Set.range_id' }
+  refine ⟨S, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
+  exact locallyFinitelyPresented_of_isZero _
+    (((ProEtale.upperStar A _).mapMod R).map_isZero hM)
+
+
+/-- A constructible module placed in degree zero stays bounded constructible after any shift.
+
+Source: the shifted-single isomorphism and the defining homology criterion for
+`boundedConstructible`. Its cohomology in degree `-n` is the original module, and all
+other cohomology objects are zero. Transport constructibility through these isomorphisms.
+(blueprint: lem-poincare-constructible-shift-single) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_shift_single
+    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A) R)
+    (hM : IsConstructibleModuleObject R M) (n : ℤ) :
+    boundedConstructible R
+      ((shiftFunctor _ n).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) := by
+  let K := (shiftFunctor _ n).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
+  let e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ (-n)).obj M :=
+    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctors _).shiftIso n (-n) 0 (by simp)).app M
+  have : K.IsGE (-n) := DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.isGE_of_iso e.symm (-n)
+  have : K.IsLE (-n) := DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.isLE_of_iso e.symm (-n)
+  apply (mem_boundedConstructible_iff R K).mpr
+  constructor
+  · refine ⟨-n, -n, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
+    rcases hi with hi | hi
+    · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE K (-n) i hi
+    · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isLE K (-n) i hi
+  · intro i
+    by_cases hi : i = -n
+    · subst i
+      exact constructible_of_iso R
+        (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-n)).mapIso e) ≪≫
+          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso _ (-n)).app M).symm hM
+    · apply constructible_of_isZero
+      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hi with hi | hi
+      · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE K (-n) i hi
+      · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isLE K (-n) i hi
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale

+/-! Geometric and shift components of the bounded-constructibility argument. -/
+
+@[expose] public section

+universe u u'
+
+open CategoryTheory MonoidalCategory MonoidalClosed
+open MonObj Limits ZeroObject
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale
+
+variable (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
+
+private lemma finitelyPresented_of_regular_iso
+    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj R]
+    {M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) R}
+    (e : M ≅ Mod.regular R) : Mod.IsFinitelyPresented R M := by
+  refine ⟨1, 0, 0, ⟨?_⟩⟩
+  exact e ≪≫ (biproductUniqueIso (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Mod.regular R)).symm ≪≫
+    (cokernelZeroIsoTarget (X := Mod.finiteFree R 0)).symm
+
+/-- The zero Tate twist is the regular module, hence constructible.
+
+Source: the zero clause of `tateTwistNat`. Use the identity stratum and identity cover.
+Each inverse image preserves the tensor unit, and the regular module has the presentation
+with one generator and no relations.
+(blueprint: lem-poincare-zero-twist-constructible) -/
+lemma zeroTwist_constructible : IsConstructibleModuleObject
+    (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X) (tateTwist X ℓ 0) := by
+  let R := condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X
+  let S : Scheme.Stratification X :=
+    { n := 1
+      stratum := fun _ ↦ Set.univ
+      isLocallyClosed_stratum := fun _ ↦ isOpen_univ.isLocallyClosed
+      isConstructible_stratum := fun _ ↦ Topology.IsConstructible.univ
+      iUnion_stratum_eq_univ := Set.iUnion_const _
+      pairwise_disjoint_stratum := fun i j hij ↦ (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
+      domain := fun _ ↦ X
+      immersion := fun _ ↦ 𝟙 X
+      range_immersion := fun _ ↦ Set.range_id' }
+  refine ⟨S, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
+  refine ⟨.singleton (𝟙 X) (Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isIso _), fun i ↦ ?_⟩
+  let F := upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)
+  let G := upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (𝟙 X)
+  let : F.Braided := {}
+  let : G.Braided := {}
+  exact finitelyPresented_of_regular_iso _
+    ((G.mapMod (F.obj R)).mapIso F.mapModUnitIso.symm ≪≫ G.mapModUnitIso.symm)
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale
